A starting point—not a verdict

Your solution brief

  1. Clarify the outcome. Write down the smallest result that would meaningfully improve the situation.
  2. Run a reversible test. Try one low-cost action for seven days and record what changes.
  3. Compare with peers. Review solutions from people with similar context before scaling the approach.
Assumptions & limits

This prototype response is illustrative. A production answer would cite sources, flag uncertainty, and route high-risk topics to qualified help.
